title: The meter writes an empty line after each message, so that people reading its output can tell one message from the next; the encoding is one named function
covers: something other than a message written on a message channel
the message is encoded by a function declaration, which the check does not follow
note: The meter's own test skips empty lines (filter(Boolean)) and passes. billing splits standard output on line ends and parses every line: JSON.parse('') throws in its data handler, and its meter tests fail.
